SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(fg3m) AS three_pointers_made, SUM(fg3a) AS three_pointers_attempted, SUM(fg3m) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(fg3a), 0) AS three_point_pct
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
ORDER BY three_pointers_made DESC, player_name ASC
LIMIT 10
